articles.title: Korea abolishes Prosecutors' Office after 78 years, putting new criminal justice system to test
articles.description: Korea on Friday abolished the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office after 78 years and launched two new state agencies dividing its investigative and prosecutorial powers, ushering in one of the most sweeping changes to the country’s criminal justice system in decades.
